remarks: Welcome to this unique 1-bedroom apartment, one of the few high ceiling loft-style units in the complex, offering an abundance of sunlight and charm. The sun-splashed kitchen features beautiful ceramic countertops, tile flooring, and skylights that fill the space with natural light. Hardwood floors run throughout the home, and there's a washer/dryer conveniently located in the unit.  Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day on your large private deck with views that capture the beauty of the outdoors. Located on the 3rd floor, this apartment offers a peaceful retreat. Convenient located just minutes from downtown shopping, restaurants and train.
